response: Yes, adults with mild intellectual disabilities can improve their reading comprehension ability. Research has shown that targeted interventions, such as specialized reading instruction, assistive technology, and adaptive strategies, can help individuals with mild intellectual disabilities enhance their reading skills, including comprehension. Additionally, tailored support and accommodations, like visual aids and simplified language, can also facilitate improved reading comprehension. With consistent practice, patience, and the right support, many adults with mild intellectual disabilities can make significant progress in their reading comprehension abilities.
